verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a cloud SaaS that processes customer task data, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no training-data policy, opt-out control, or no-training commitment. Self-hosting gives infrastructure control but is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
